title: [Wynn] Specialist For Mythics
description: This resource pack changes Wynntils' Mythic Found and Cache Found jingles into the Specialist song from Persona 4.
body:
Made to be used on the [Wynncraft](https://wynncraft.com/) server only!

[Preview](https://youtu.be/V_aRC8Vxies)

Requires [Wynntils](https://modrinth.com/mod/wynntils) mod.
Ensure the "Valuable Found" option is enabled in Wynntils and that a sound is selected.

For any issues, contact @dryoxzy on Discord! _(or ping me in Wynncord)_
